name: Bridget Wells
bioAdditions: Akerly says Henry Tuthill married Bridget in England. She came to America with him, survived him, and married second William Wells, Gent., of Southold; her children John and Elizabeth Tuthill were Wells's wards (S1). Savage (via Akerly) says Henry and Bridget both died before 1650.

sources.citation: L. D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898), pp. 6-9 (nos. 2-11)
sources.supports: Bridget, wife of Henry Tuthill, then of William Wells
